You always start the game.
In each move, a player now takes 1, 2, 3 or 4 sticks from the pile.
You always take the number of sticks so that you are sure to win.
In your first move you take 3 sticks so that you are sure to win.
Find the nth term for the sequence of the possible number of sticks in the pile at the start.
Use your answers to 4(a) and 6 to help you.
............................................................. [2]
subject: International Mathematics
